# Michael Malakhov (SOWA_DEV)

> Resume and portfolio of Michael Malakhov, Fullstack Developer: project case studies and a blog.
> The resume is available as Markdown and PDF in Russian (ru) and English (en); the page
> language is set by the path prefix (/ru, /en).

## Resume (machine-readable)

- [Resume, Markdown, English](/resume/en.md): best form for LLMs, plain text
- [Resume, Markdown, Russian](/resume/ru.md): same content in Russian
- [Resume, PDF, English](/resume/en.pdf): printable version
- [Resume, PDF, Russian](/resume/ru.pdf): printable version in Russian

Each post is available under /en/blog/<slug> and /ru/blog/<slug>.
